title: WoW: Forever is the biggest launch in WoW history 🏆
subject: wowforever
description:
Did you go back to Azeroth for Forever? 👇

Blizzard says World of Warcraft: Forever, which launched on PC via Battle.net on November 4, 2026, had the biggest launch in WoW history by peak concurrent players and the highest number of returning players ever. Blizzard did not share a player count.

Sources: Official Warcraft social post (Nov 7, 2026) via Windows Central, Windows Central (Nov 5, 2026), KitGuru, PC Games Hardware

scenes.text: World of Warcraft: Forever just broke Blizzard's own record.
Blizzard says it's the biggest launch in WoW history by peak concurrent players.
scenes.search: pc gamer playing mmo dark room

scenes.text: It also pulled back more returning players than ever.
There's no number attached. Windows Central says the old peak belonged to Wrath of the Lich King, from 2008.
Forever went live on PC through Battle.net on November 4, running on megaservers instead of separate realms.
Blizzard vice president Holly Longdale described launch week on X as so far so goodish.
